:::{#sol-transpose-product-practice}

No.
The left side is

$$
\matr{A}\matr{B} = \sbmat{1 \cd 1 + 2 \cd 3 & 1 \cd 0 + 2 \cd 1 \\ 0 \cd 1 + 1 \cd 3 & 0 \cd 0 + 1 \cd 1}
= \sbmat{7 & 2 \\ 3 & 1},
\qquad
\tp{(\matr{A}\matr{B})} = \sbmat{7 & 3 \\ 2 & 1}.
$$

The right side is

$$
\tp{\matr{A}}\,\tp{\matr{B}}
= \sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1} \sbmat{1 & 3 \\ 0 & 1}
= \sbmat{1 & 3 \\ 2 & 7}.
$$

These differ in two entries.
@thm-transpose-product gives the order that does match:
$\tp{\matr{B}}\,\tp{\matr{A}} = \sbmat{1 & 3 \\ 0 & 1} \sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1} = \sbmat{7 & 3 \\ 2 & 1}$.

:::
